summary: The Concept fleet's learning 'One cooldown for the skim and the hull hides every hull contact' is now L-STU-177 (it was L-STU-102, the same id Brittle Star Studio's entry holds); its text is unchanged, and nothing in CONCEPT_FLEET.md cited it by id.
why: Both entries had carried L-STU-102 since Ys-bleeding-edge's 2026-10-18 merge of bleeding-edge (733b3cd282 renumbered it from L-STU-80, 23 s after Brittle Star claimed 102), and Brittle Star's landed on bleeding-edge first (#1223 on 2026-10-18, before #1201 on 2026-10-25), so the Concept fleet's moves. Cite it as L-STU-177 from now on.
